project.name: Toolkit Guardrails
project.summary: Canonical host-neutral guardrail policy with deterministic normalisation, repository-resolution interpretation, command classification, policy lookup, and non-approval decision calculation contracts. Stateful approval verification consumes volatile, in-memory, process-local replay state that is non-durable, non-distributed, non-cross-process, and reset when the Node.js process restarts. This source-only reference implementation is not native-host enforcement, restart-safe production replay protection, or production-distributed replay protection.
